subject: Request: startup sponsorship & usage boost for accelerator demo
messages:
From: Sarah Kim <sarah@novafoundry.com>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.com
Cc: partnerships@novafoundry.com
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask — usage sponsorship for accelerator demo

Hi Jordan,

We're two weeks out from our accelerator demo day and running a spike to finalize a prototype that relies heavily on embeddings + chat. Usage is higher than expected and our trial credits will run out next Monday.

Would Redwood consider a short, targeted sponsorship to cover increased inference during the demo window? We're asking for an extra 30k tokens worth of credits (or equivalent usage uplift) for 30 days, with a short follow-up call to share results and give Redwood demo visibility at the program showcase.

What I'd need to move quickly:
- Confirmation of credit amount and duration
- Any simple agreement or approval process (DocuSign ok)

I've attached a small usage snapshot so you can see the recent run-rate. Happy to jump on a quick 15-min call if helpful.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Kim
Head of Partnerships | NovaFoundry
attachments: usage_snapshot_aug2026.csv (CSV, 12KB)
From: jordan_blake@redwood.com
To: Sarah Kim <sarah@novafoundry.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask — usage sponsorship for accelerator demo

Thanks for the note, Sarah — and congrats on demo week. Before I loop in approvals, quick questions so I can make the ask concrete:

- Do you have an estimate of how many tokens (or API calls) you'd consume during the 30-day spike? Your CSV helps but we need a 2-week forward projection.
- Is there any promotional visibility requirement (logo, demo shoutout) or SLA you'd want?
- Will you sign a short sponsorship addendum / MSA amendment?

CCing Marissa (growth credits) and Laura (finance) to assess the ask. If you can reply with a short usage estimate and confirm you can sign a DocuSign, I can escalate today.

Cheers,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive — Startup Programs
Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: jordan_blake@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask — usage sponsorship for accelerator demo

Jordan / team — we can approve a one-time sponsorship for NovaFoundry with these constraints:

Proposal (internal):
- Grant: 40,000 token-equivalent credits
- Duration: 60 days (from activation)
- Conditions: Redwood logo on demo slide + a short case study post-demo if usage exceeds 30k tokens
- Approvals: finance sign-off (Laura) + signed addendum (DocuSign)

Rationale: NovaFoundry is in a high-visibility cohort and this looks like a good PLG motion; 40k tokens buys the team breathing room and increases chance of conversion.

I'll prepare the sponsorship addendum and the DocuSign link. Attaching a draft term sheet to speed things up.

Marissa Cole
Head of Growth Programs
Redwood Inference
attachments: term_sheet_v2.pdf (PDF, 45KB)
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask — usage sponsorship for accelerator demo

A couple of comments from a commercial perspective:

- Alternate path: 30k token credit + 3 months 25% discount on billed consumption up to $5k/month (if they convert to paid). This reduces upfront subsidy but gives a conversion incentive.
- If we go straight 40k free, let's tie the ROI ask: 1 short quote + demo spotlight (as Marissa suggested).
- Deal id: DF-8421 (please add to HubSpot).

I'll defer to finance for final sign-off on duration, but I'm OK with the 60-day window if we get the case study commitment.

Ben Carter
Sales — Strategic Startups
Redwood Inference
From: Sarah Kim <sarah@novafoundry.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Cc: partnerships@novafoundry.com
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2026 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask — usage sponsorship for accelerator demo

Thanks everyone — this is great news.

We accept the 40k token sponsorship and the 60-day activation window. We can confirm the demo slide placement and a 300–500 word post-demo quote/case blurb if the usage goes past 30k, happy to coordinate.

We'll sign the addendum via DocuSign — please send the link (or the draft if you want any edits).

For your records, estimated spike: ~22k tokens/week for the next 3 weeks (peak demo prep), then taper.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — happy to feature Redwood in the showcase if that's helpful.

Best,
Sarah
Head of Partnerships | NovaFoundry
